verdict.rationale: A tax agency with online filing and payment services could plausibly publish a machine-readable API spec, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no such spec: every candidate OpenAPI and Swagger path returned 404, and the docs describe only human-facing Online Services, Web File and Quick Pay features. Mentions of approved third-party tax software do not amount to a downloadable API spec from the department.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
